title: Adversarial domain adaptation for false-positive reduction in hospital-to-robotic echocardiographic screening under limited target-domain data.
summary: Domain adaptation improves specificity of echocardiographic screening when transferring a model from hospital images to a robotic acquisition domain; the robot cohort contains healthy subjects, so this supports false-positive reduction rather than pathology sensitivity.
ai_technology: Domain-adversarial neural adaptation adjusts the echocardiographic classifier to robotic acquisition data.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Domain adaptation improves specificity of echocardiographic screening when transferring a model from hospital images to a robotic acquisition domain; the robot cohort contains healthy subjects, so this supports false-positive reduction rather than pathology sensitivity.
evidence.unknown: Hospital test cohort and healthy robotic data support specificity only; no robotic pathology sensitivity or prospective clinical outcome is established.
